alignment.source: wallclock-fixed.json (offset and drift as given, in the re-based clock; the drift was read from `drift_ppm` (+0.000 ppm))
alignment.the_note: THE WALL CLOCK, NOT THE CLAPS. The two devices' clocks have never been compared, so this alignment carries the device-to-device skew -- the constant the corpus cannot measure -- and a drift the duet's 236 s cannot separate from a movement. zcode's clap alignment replaces this sidecar when it lands.
alignment.the_resolution: this sidecar carries NO CLAP TIMES, so the alignment's resolution cannot be measured from it -- the offset is as good as whatever produced it, and where that was the wall clock, it carries the device-to-device skew the corpus cannot measure
alignment.the_drift: the drift was read from `drift_ppm` (+0.000 ppm)

the_pose.the_note: the device orientation attached to every frame
the_pose.the_what_this_does_not_license: there is NO POSITION in the pose, so the device cannot be placed in the room, and the heading is null, so its azimuth is unknown: a relative pose against another view cannot be solved from this bundle, and the SCALE certainly is not in it

the_what_the_take_supports: the roving device's alpha (the azimuth-like tilt) over the session: 1.7 to 351.2 degrees
the roving device's beta (the pitch) over the session: 5.3 to 99.0 degrees
the roving device's gamma (the roll) over the session: -84.3 to 73.7 degrees
the_what_the_take_does_not_support: the roving device's HEADING is null in every frame, so its azimuth is unknown and the two views' relative ROTATION cannot be solved either
the roving device's POSITION was never recorded, so it cannot be placed in the room and the relative TRANSLATION is not measurable from this bundle

the_channels.the_rule: each channel's SIGNAL threshold -- the threshold at which that channel is on 90 % of its frames -- and the crossings it finds at that threshold and at its grain floor

the_signal_threshold.the_rule: the threshold at which this channel is on 90 % of its frames: the 10th percentile of its per-frame change-map maxima
the_signal_threshold.the_convention: nearest rank: the k-th smallest observed per-frame maximum, k = ceil((1 - duty) * n) = 187
the_signal_threshold.the_note: A SIGNAL THRESHOLD, NOT A GRAIN FLOOR. The floor asks "is there anything here at all"; this asks "is this channel reading the room". It is a property of THIS recording, so it is measured here and not borrowed. THE MAXIMA CARRY 246 TIES AT THE THRESHOLD, so the share of frames above it is what the ties give and not the target. 246 of 1865 frames have a maximum of EXACTLY zero, so this channel is quiet only when the recorder repeats a picture.

the_signal_threshold.the_rule: the threshold at which this channel is on 90 % of its frames: the 10th percentile of its per-frame change-map maxima
the_signal_threshold.the_convention: nearest rank: the k-th smallest observed per-frame maximum, k = ceil((1 - duty) * n) = 11
the_signal_threshold.the_note: A SIGNAL THRESHOLD, NOT A GRAIN FLOOR. The floor asks "is there anything here at all"; this asks "is this channel reading the room". It is a property of THIS recording, so it is measured here and not borrowed.

the_graded_witness.the_note: the raw reading is the one that was asked for first; the log reading was added after the raw one was seen, so it is a SECOND reading and not a replacement. Neither is called the answer here: the slide null says how much of each is the room and how much is two slow series correlating somewhere by luck.

at_the_grain_floor.the_note: the roving view found no crossings at all. The corpus detector needs a blob that holds its shape while it TRANSLATES, and a channel that changes everywhere -- a hand-held camera, whose whole picture moves -- has no such blob. That is a finding about the channel, not a failure of the render.

overlap.the_criterion: the two crossings' intervals overlap at all

half.the_criterion: they share at least half of the SHORTER one

the_crossing_witness.the_note: the roving view found no crossings at all. That is a finding about the channel, not a failure of the render.

the_rendering_choices.the_moment_rule: the roving stream's own frames, each carried into the fixed clock by the alignment
